title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta47

## Managed schedule battery-owned resume
- Stops using the mower's ambiguous Docked/Charging/Idle state as the trigger for low-battery Resume. A notification-confirmed low-battery interruption now waits for the mower to resume its retained task by itself.
- Uses the mower/user `charging_limit` setting as the only automatic fallback threshold. After the battery reaches that configured limit, Navimower waits 3 additional minutes before considering a fallback Resume.
- Re-reads the scheduler time window immediately before every Resume or `reset=false` continuation command. If the window has closed, no mowing command is sent.
- Keeps window-closed interruptions separate from low-battery interruptions: a task Navimower itself stopped at the end of the allowed window is still resumed when the next window opens.
- Preserves the active zone/cycle/progress across low-battery charging and never uses `reset=true` to recover an interrupted task.
- Exposes the interruption reason and charging-limit timestamp in Schedule Status/diagnostics so field tests can distinguish mower-owned charging waits from window-owned stops.
- Migrates a persisted beta40-beta46 low-battery `resume_pending` state into the new charging-limit wait without issuing an immediate Resume after upgrade.
